name: Greater Yellowlegs
rangeDescription: Alaska and canada; winters to southern south america
description: Fairly large shorebird with bright yellow legs. Plumage is essentially identical to Lesser Yellowlegs: gray upperparts with white speckling, streaky neck, and white belly.

name: Huambo Cisticola
rangeDescription: West-central angola
description: Large, plain, long-tailed cisticola with a rufous cap, gray-brown back, and pale whitish underparts. Found in open habitats with grass and small trees, often in rugged and mountainous areas.

name: White-throated Jay
rangeDescription: Oak-pine forest of southwestern mexico (southern guerrero and south-central oaxaca)
description: Small, beautifully patterned jay. Very local in humid evergreen and pine-evergreen forest of mountains; endemic to southwestern Mexico.

name: Luzon Flameback
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (luzon, polillo, catanduanes, and marinduque)
description: A large woodpecker of lowland and foothill wooded areas on Luzon and neighboring islands, with a red back, a yellowish belly with indistinct patterning, and black on the tail, edge to the wing, neck, and chest. Note the obvious white spotting on the chest, neck, and line behind the eye.

name: Rufous-backed Redstart
rangeDescription: Montane forest of central asia; winters to iran and northern india
description: Stunning male has black mask, silvery cap, white wing patches, and bright orange back and underparts. Female is grayish-brown with paler underparts, fainter wingbars, a rufous tail, and a weak eye-ring.

name: Wilson's Phalarope
rangeDescription: Breeds canada and usa; winters in western and southern south america
description: Slender shorebird known for spinning frantically on water to stir up small invertebrates. Note needle-thin bill, longer and thinner than other phalaropes.

name: Marvelous Spatuletail
rangeDescription: Andes of northern peru (along east bank of río utcubamba)
description: Celebrated hummingbird restricted to Andean cloud forest in northern Peru. With his outrageous tail, blue crown, and iridescent green throat, the male ranks as one of the world’s most spectacular birds.

name: Raiatea Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Western society islands (bora bora, tahaa, huahine, and maupiti)
description: An unmistakable dove with a bright silver head, neck, and chest, dark green wings, a light green belly, and a yellowish tint to the forehead. Bill is bright banana yellow.

name: Fringe-backed Fire-eye
rangeDescription: Lowlands of coastal eastern brazil (southern sergipe and coastal northeastern bahia)
description: Medium-sized antbird. Males are black with a large white patch on the back and females are brown overall, paler below, with grayish sides of the head.

name: Yellow-legged Pigeon
rangeDescription: Bismarck archipelago and solomon islands
description: Body is mostly iridescent green below and dark blue above and on the wings, with diagnostic bright yellow legs and a bright silver head with pinkish yellow-tipped bill. Most often seen in flight in small flocks over forest canopy at dusk and dawn, where flocking behavior and combination of silver head and bright yellow legs are diagnostic.

name: Chestnut Sparrow
rangeDescription: Central chad, southwestern sudan, south sudan, and southwestern ethiopia to northeastern uganda, kenya, and central and eastern tanzania
description: An unusual small, richly colored sparrow of dry country. Males are completely chestnut with a darker head.

name: Western Tragopan
rangeDescription: Himalayas of northern pakistan to northwestern india and adjacent southwestern tibet
description: A large, short-tailed pheasant. Male appears mostly dark with prominent white dots all over.

name: Rodrigues Fody
rangeDescription: Rodrigues (eastern mascarene islands)
description: A sparrow-like weaver. The mostly yellow breeding males are distinctive, but females and non-breeding males are drab.

name: Blue-fronted Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Buru (southern moluccas)
description: A small, bright green parrot with a short pointed tail, confined to the island of Buru. Note the orange bill and legs and the subtle blue patch on the rear crown, which is brighter in males.

name: Cameroon Olive-Greenbul
rangeDescription: Montane forest of southeastern nigeria and southwestern cameroon; bioko
description: An active but easily overlooked long-tailed greenbul found in flocks in the understory and along the edges of montane forest. Can be found near ant swarms.

name: Long-billed Woodcreeper
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southwestern venezuela, northern bolivia, amazonian brazil, and french guiana
description: This large and unmistakable woodcreeper is widespread across much of Amazonia. It has a long pinkish bill, white throat, and distinct white streaking on the neck and breast.

name: Canebrake Wren
rangeDescription: Eastern nicaragua to eastern costa rica and northwestern panama (western bocas del toro)
description: Small, skulking wren of foothills and lowlands along the Caribbean slope from Nicaragua south to western Panama. Found in forest edges, second-growth thickets, and brushy fields with cane grass.

name: Saipan Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Saipan and alamagan (northern mariana islands)
description: A relatively large plain brown reed warbler with a pale throat, a yellowish face, a darker cap and tail, and an absurdly long decurved bill. Found in areas of tall dense grasses, reed marshes, and scrubby thickets up to 400 meters of elevation.

name: Nilgiri Sholakili
rangeDescription: Peninsular india (nilgiri hills of mysore and western madras)
description: Dumpy little bird, slaty-blue with a tan belly. Highly restricted and scattered range in the Nilgiri Hills, where it is found at 900-2100 meters of elevation in sholas (patches of stunted montane forest separated by open grassy areas).

name: Hook-billed Bulbul
rangeDescription: Lowland forest of borneo, eastern sumatra, and bangka island
description: A highly localized species, found almost exclusively in the kerangas and peatswamp forests of Borneo and Sumatra’s lowlands (rarely in adjacent wooded habitats). Fairly plain overall; note brown upperparts, off-white chest, pale yellow belly, and elegant white eyebrow.
